title: A new selection problem for degenerate viscous Hamilton-Jacobi equations
summary: We study a selection problem for degenerate viscous Hamilton--Jacobi equations with convex Hamiltonians, in which the approximation procedure combines a nonlinear discounted approximation with a small potential perturbation. A key question is how their simultaneous effects influence the asymptotic selection of viscosity solutions of the associated ergodic problem.
